verdict.rationale: SerpApi's evidence describes scraping keyword-based results from Google, Bing, etc. (serpapi-docs-1, serpapi-gh-6) and provides RAG/feed-to-LLM use cases (serpapi-docs-25), but nothing indicates it performs meaning-based/semantic search or surfaces results that keyword engines would miss — it merely mirrors the underlying search engine's keyword results. No vector search, embeddings, or semantic ranking capability is mentioned anywhere in the pack.
